replay.note: the advocates' outputs were replayed from an earlier run and not regenerated by this one: only the judge was called, so the figures here measure the judge's behaviour on fixed inputs and not the whole pipeline

discarded_claims.claim: POL-NS-01 limb (b) and the POL-NS-02 proximity test are satisfied. The driver's trace holds 23 consecutive fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, sitting 18.1 m to 29.3 m from the pickup pin at 6.1 m to 11.9 m reported accuracy, well inside the 25 m accuracy filter, running from 12:30:00. The first in-geofence fix is five seconds from the 12:29:55 arrival marker and the derived dwell_start_offset_sec is -5.0 s; there is no clock-skew finding here and POL-NS-08(a) would require more than 90 seconds before that match could be called unsafe.
discarded_claims.reason: Cites EV-GPS-00211, which is impaired (weight_multiplier 0.39), without disclosing the impairment or naming its issue codes (GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE). POL-GEN-02(1) requires both in the same claim; silence discards.

discarded_claims.claim: The 'arrived' marker at 12:29:55 is not a false arrival under POL-NS-05, so the waiting clock runs from the marker as recorded and needs no recomputation. At the marker the driver's device reported 18.1 m from the pin - far inside the 50 m STANDARD radius, nowhere near the 300 m distance trigger - and the trace reports a 0.0 km/h speed alongside his stationary kerbside hold, so the 15 km/h motion trigger is not met either. Limb (iii) of POL-NS-05 applies: the marker is genuine, and it does not defeat the fee.
discarded_claims.reason: Cites EV-GPS-00211 (weight_multiplier 0.39) without disclosing the impairment or naming its issue codes (GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE). POL-GEN-02(1) requires both; silence discards.

discarded_claims.claim: The 500 s longest_qualifying_run figure cannot be used to satisfy the dwell: it is a span drawn across the outage, not a demonstrated presence through it. Its fix_count of 35 is exactly the sum of the two split runs' 23 and 12 fixes, so not one fix inside 12:33:40-12:36:28 places the driver in the geofence. Reading the presence as a single 500 s run, or as an accumulated 332 s, is reachable only by adding the two intervals together - which is what POL-NS-06(i) permits solely where a present and populated traffic_advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covers the pickup road. EV-ADVIS-00211-01 is MISSING and carries weight 0.0, so limb (i) is unavailable, the separate intervals may not be summed and the gap may not be bridged. I cite that artifact only for its absence, as POL-GEN-02 permits.
discarded_claims.reason: Rests on EV-GPS-00211 (weight_multiplier 0.39) but never discloses that the artifact is impaired and names no issue codes (GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE); it discusses the outage only as an argument. POL-GEN-02(1) requires the impairment and its codes to be disclosed in the same claim; silence discards.

ruling.explanation:
Both of you: this one cannot be decided on the record, so it goes to a human reviewer. The SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is HELD — not collected from the rider and not refunded, and no payment to the driver — while that review is pending.

What is settled. The driver reached Blk 79 Toa Payoh Central and tapped 'arrived' at 12:29:55, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 12:38:20 on RIDER_NO_SHOW (EV-TRIP-00211), so POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d) are made out on the trip record alone. The trace puts him 18.1–29.3 m from the pin at 6.1–11.9 m accuracy and stationary, so limb (b) is met. The 12:29:55 marker was not a false arrival (POL-NS-05 not engaged), and the driver answered the rider's 12:31:02 message at 12:31:20, so POL-NS-04 does not apply to the rider.

What cannot be decided. Limb (c) — a continuous 300 s hold for STANDARD. EV-GPS-00211 is IMPAIRED: weight 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE. It loses 168 s of fixes from 12:33:40 to 12:36:28, inside the waiting window, splitting the driver's in-geofence presence into a 220 s run and a 112 s run. Those runs cannot be added: POL-NS-06(i) permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a present, populated traffic advisory covers the pickup road, and EV-ADVIS-00211-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT, citable for its absence only). So the 500 s span and the 332 s accumulation the trace summary offers are not usable, and the trace can show neither that the driver stayed on the kerb nor that he left it.

The only record from inside that blackout is the driver's own 12:35:10 chat message. It is his account, not a measurement, and fixes no position; it therefore cannot satisfy a limb whose test is the GPS measurement, and it does not stop the impaired trace being the only measurement evidence of the dwell.

Consequence. The deciding fact rests on an artifact impaired under POL-NS-08(b), so the ruling may not exceed a partial refund and escalates; confidence is capped at that artifact's 0.39, below the platform's 0.70 floor. The case escalates under POL-NS-09(a) and (e). Open question for the reviewer: did the driver hold the pickup geofence continuously for 300 s across 12:33:40–12:36:28 — for example from an uninterrupted trace or another independent record of his position?

On the claims. The driver's reading that limb (c) is met on a 500 s run is rejected: that figure bridges the blackout, which POL-NS-06(i) forbids, and a party's account cannot supply a measurement limb; POL-NS-07 therefore does not engage and no SGD 3.20 is payable. The driver's point that limbs (a) and (d) hold, and that the arrival marker was genuine, is accepted. His point that the rider's own words fix fault on her side is context on conduct, not the dwell, and does not decide the fee. The rider's reading that the dwell is only 220 s is also not established: the measured continuous run is indeed 220 s, but because the trace's own blackout leaves continuity open, that does not establish a shortfall, and the SGD 4.00 refund cannot be grounded on this record either. Her points that she was present (36 of 55 fixes inside 100 m), that POL-NS-04 is unavailable to her because the driver replied inside 120 s, that the refund figure would be exactly SGD 4.00, and that the rider's shortfall does not depend on reading the blackout as presence, are all noted but none of them decides the fee.
